notes: >-
  DRAFT — serialized from the finished WCAG-EM 2.0 evaluation delivered
  2026-07-28 (evaluation_id rcm-2026q3) for review by RiverCity Metro Authority.
  This is not a signed or issued conformance claim.


  Scope and method: the conformance target is WCAG 2.2 Level AA. The evaluation
  ran 2026-06-22 through 2026-07-28 against an accessibility-support baseline of
  NVDA 2026.1 + Firefox 141 (Windows 11), VoiceOver + Safari 18 (macOS 15),
  TalkBack 15 + Chrome (Android 15), and keyboard-only without a screen reader.
  Technologies relied upon on the web surface: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React),
  WAI-ARIA.


  Component coverage: only the web component is populated. Every adherence term
  in Tables 1 and 2 rests on the 12 sampled web pages (11 structured + 1 random)
  and the web complete process P01 — sampling supports statements about the
  sample set and never a whole-product conformance claim. The electronic-docs,
  software, and authoring-tool components are omitted from criteria entries
  because the web measurement stack did not evaluate them. The non-web surfaces
  that were examined are carried as boundary statements only. The RideRC native
  app's ticket-activation flow was covered by a manual TalkBack and VoiceOver
  session on 2026-07-15 — see the disabled Software chapter. The monthly PDF
  timetables were covered by a manual document check on 2026-07-16, which
  recorded finding a11y_timetable_pdf_untagged (fingerprint b1590f3e, MAJOR):
  two sampled PDFs are untagged, with no structural tags and no programmatic
  reading order. This catalog has no electronic-documents chapter and the
  electronic-docs component is not populated here, so that evidence appears as a
  boundary statement and not as a conformance result; the conclusion is the
  Authority's to make with its publishing team, as the native-app conclusion is
  its mobile team's. The third-party real-time vehicle map iframe is excluded by
  the engagement letter — vendor-supplied and not remediable this cycle.


  Completeness: all 32 Level A and 24 Level AA criteria in this catalog carry a
  term; none was left untested. 3.1.2 Language of Parts — the one criterion still
  open when the base window closed on 2026-07-24 — was closed by the follow-up
  session of 2026-07-28.


  Terms and severity are orthogonal: adherence terms are derived only from the
  per-criterion outcome map across the sample set, and finding severity appears
  in the remarks as impact information, never as a reason to raise or lower a
  term. 4.1.1 Parsing is recorded not-applicable because WCAG 2.2 removed the
  criterion while the VPAT 2.5 catalog retains its row.

  S03 route schedule, S04 service alerts, S05 fares, S06 account dashboard, S07
  checkout steps 1–2, S08 contact + paratransit application form, S09 news
  article, S10 accessibility policy, S11 title-vi (legacy info-page template).
  Random sample R01 /riders/lost-and-found, drawn by seeded shuffle of the
  214-URL sitemap, seed 7391. Complete processes P01 plan trip → buy monthly pass
  → confirmation (web; default and declined-payment error branches) and P02
  activate a purchased ticket in the RideRC native app (manual AT session,
  outside the web measurement stack). The representativeness check added S11
  after R01 surfaced a 2019 legacy info-page template missing from the structured
  set; the second comparison surfaced no further content or finding types. Web
  samples were covered in default, loading, error, and expanded states where the
  template has them, using automated scanning (axe), driven keyboard and
  screen-reader sessions, and manual review against the accessibility-support
  baseline. The monthly PDF timetables were checked in a separate manual document
  session, also outside the web measurement stack.
